rationale: Recent close misses suggest tail float-budget reallocation is live, but fixed suffix rescues have plateaued. This keeps the current reverse recurrent-tail baseline intact and adds a late quant-aware greedy selector that spends about one extra FP16 matrix worth of budget on the most quantization-sensitive late-block tensor, directly targeting final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact val_bpb rather than train loss.
title: Greedy Tail FP16 Rescue Selection
